did_you_know.title: In their campaign for women's voting rights, hundreds of suffragettes march to t…
did_you_know.text: In their campaign for women's voting rights, hundreds of suffragettes march to the British Parliament in London. Several are beaten by police, newspaper attention embarrasses the authorities, and the march is dubbed Black Friday.
